Callers: upload_logo/cover/carousel/gallery/decor/product/brand, chat (attachments.py:36), proof (public.py:236), feed image (feed.py:146), changelog (viewset.py:152), AI design (ai_design.py:3128), remove-background preview is NOT persisted. Exception: feed video is raw bytes by design — see hardening.

local_checks.invariant: Object keys are server-generated, tenant-scoped, and not injectable or client-writable; no filename/traversal reaches the key.
local_checks.result: Holds. Keys are f'stores/{store.id}/{folder}/{uuid4().hex}.{ext}', 'chat/{thread.id}/{uuid}.webp', 'changelog/{uuid}.{ext}', 'system/offers/{slug}/{uuid}.webp'. No serializer exposes image_key/media_key/logo_key/cover_key/label_key as writable. 'kind' validated against StoreGalleryImage.KINDS. default_storage.save uses uuid names — no collision/traversal.

local_checks.invariant: Chat attachments are never publicly fetchable: private bucket objects get short-lived signed URLs only to thread owner/staff; local fallback lives under a prefix nginx refuses to serve.
local_checks.result: Holds. R2 path: key 'chat/<thread>/<uuid>.webp' -> object_url(private=True, expires=3600) -> presigned SigV4, public base ignored. Local path: key 'private/chat/...' via default_storage; nginx 'location ^~ /media/private/ { return 404; }' precedes '/media/' on BOTH vhosts; Django static() media serving exists only under settings.DEBUG. Attachment endpoint enforces IsAuthenticated + chat_enabled + owner-or-staff, serves local files via default_storage.open(image_key) with DB-sourced key (no traversal), redirects to fresh 1h presigned URL otherwise. chat_image_url always private=True.

local_checks.invariant: Payment proofs are private objects: signed URLs only, first-write-wins, quota-accounted, released on unpaid close; public tracking never exposes the proof URL.
local_checks.result: Mostly holds. Upload requires valid tracking_token + PENDING_PAYMENT + non-MP + no existing proof; validate+normalize->WebP; _check_quota fast-path then Store->Order select_for_update recheck; orphan _delete_object on failure; response object_url(key, private=True). Owner serializer get_proof_image uses private=True; public tracking payload exposes only proof_uploaded bool. release_proof deletes row+object+frees quota inside the locking atomic on EXPIRE/CANCEL. Residual: presigned TTL defaults to 7 days vs chat's deliberate 1h — hardening, not a break.

local_checks.invariant: Upload/delete endpoints resolve the store strictly from the authenticated owner; no cross-tenant object or row access (IDOR).
local_checks.result: Holds. Store actions use get_object_or_404(Store, user__user=request.user) and child rows scoped store=store. Catalog querysets all filter store=view.my_store(); brand/product image actions go through get_object()/owner queryset. Feed post media scoped get_object_or_404(FeedPost, pk, store=store). Order proof is token-scoped to the store. Public pattern ?product= lookup filters store+is_active+not is_exclusive. Deletes take the key from the locked row, never caller input.

local_checks.invariant: Storage quota (max_storage_mb) and image-count caps are enforced atomically: fast-path check, PUT, then recheck under select_for_update on the Store row; failed transactions delete the orphaned object; deletes free quota.
local_checks.result: Holds for all store-scoped uploads. Pattern: validate->normalize->_check_image_slot/_check_quota fast-path->_put_object->atomic{Store select_for_update->recheck->write key+size->_consume_quota}->except ValueError _delete_object(key). Deletes lock Store, clear key/size, _consume_quota(freed), then _delete_object post-commit. release_proof mirrors it for proofs. Exceptions: chat attachments consume NO quota (candidate); changelog has no quota by design (platform asset, staff-only) and has a minor replace race -> orphan.

local_checks.invariant: Pattern markup served as document/srcdoc cannot execute attacker JS: handlers, scripts, dangerous URL schemes, base/meta/embeds removed; document CSP allows only nonce'd scripts in an opaque-origin sandbox.
local_checks.result: Holds with defense in depth. sanitize_markup strips <script>, on*= handlers with any quote/unquoted form, javascript:/vbscript:/data:text/html in 10 URL attributes incl. entity/whitespace-obfuscated schemes, <base>/<object>/<embed>/<iframe>/<frame>/<frameset>, and ALL <meta>. sanitize_css removes </style breakouts. pattern_document normalizes theme/surface/style attrs, escapes preload URLs, per-response validated nonce. View sets X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN + document_csp(nonce): default-src 'none', script-src 'nonce-…' (no unsafe-inline), object-src 'none', base-uri 'none', form-action 'none', connect-src 'none'. Preview token = TimestampSigner TTL 3d bound to store.pk. Even if sanitizer missed markup, CSP nonce + opaque origin block script; residual <link>/<style> are staff-authored catalog content neutralized by style-src 'unsafe-inline' — hardening note only.

local_checks.invariant: Local MEDIA_ROOT fallback cannot expose private objects in production; nginx media handling matches the storage layout.
local_checks.result: Holds. Django serves MEDIA_URL only when DEBUG; production media is nginx alias /srv/media <- media_data volume <- /app/media. Only two default_storage writers exist: chat attachments under 'private/' (nginx 404 + authed endpoint) and AI-design gallery images under 'stores/<id>/gallery/' which are public-by-design. Store-scoped R2 helpers require store_storage_configured() — no silent local fallback for proofs/changelog/feed (put_object raises ValueError without backend). proofs/changelog keys can never be served from /media/ because they are never written to default_storage.

local_checks.invariant: BYO storage: owner-supplied endpoint cannot become SSRF; credentials are write-only/encrypted; URL generation resolves the correct bucket per key; public_base_url cannot inject non-https or dangerous schemes.
local_checks.result: Holds. validate_endpoint enforces https (http only when settings.DEBUG) + host suffix allowlist. bucket regex + region default 'auto'. access_key/secret_key write-only, encrypted via vault purpose per store. _byo_backend requires enabled+endpoint+bucket+both decryptable creds else falls back to DAVENT; _store_id_from_key scopes BYO to 'stores/<id>/...' keys only — chat/changelog/system keys always DAVENT. object_url(private=True) ignores public_base_url -> presigned with owner creds when BYO. public_base_url is arbitrary https — owner could point image URLs at any host, but SPA CSP img-src https: already permits that; no new capability.

local_checks.invariant: Feed media uploads are owner-scoped, quota-accounted, and image media is normalized; public feed serves only published posts of enabled stores.
local_checks.result: Partially holds — image path is correct (validate_image_file->normalize_image 'gallery'->WebP, quota fast-path+locked recheck, old media deleted, post delete frees quota+object, owner-scoped 404s, has_feed gate). DEFECT: video branch sets processed=None then calls _put_object which does _IMAGE_CONTENT_TYPES[upload.content_type] -> KeyError for 'video/mp4|webm|quicktime' -> uncaught (view catches only ValueError) -> HTTP 500 on every video upload (feed.py:149-160 + storage.py:322-324). Feature is broken, not exploitable — hardening. Also no container/magic-byte validation would exist even if the crash were fixed (content-type only, up to 120MB raw).

local_checks.invariant: Upload endpoints have effective rate bounds so a single principal cannot amplify storage/CPU cost without limit.
local_checks.result: Mostly holds: chat_send 120/h, store_order_proof 10/h/IP, store_order_create 10/h, bg_removal 60/h, ai_design_image 60/h, store_review 10/h; XFF-spoof pinned via _pinned_ident. Throttles are deliberately fail-open on cache outage — documented; captcha still gates order creation. GAP: chat attachments have no storage-quota consumption at all (candidate) — only the hourly throttle + annual purge bound total bytes.

local_checks.invariant: Decompression bombs, animated/polyglot payloads, and orphaned objects are bounded: pixel cap enforced, single-frame output, failed transactions clean up, lifecycle deletes remove objects.
local_checks.result: Mostly holds: Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS=40M + DecompressionBombError->ValueError; output always single-frame WebP; orphan cleanup on ValueError across all helpers; purge_personal_data deletes chat attachments (R2 via _delete_object or local) for messages older than --days. Residuals (hardening): 40M pixels ~=160MB RGBA transient decode per request is generous vs <=2200px output; _open misses non-standard Pillow exceptions -> 500; chat send uploads object before send_message (DB failure -> orphan); changelog replace race can orphan; _delete_object BYO-first early return can skip the DAVENT delete for fallback-uploaded objects.

unresolved: R2 bucket public-access policy: whether R2_PUBLIC_URL/r2.dev exposes 'chat/', 'stores/*/proofs/', 'changelog/', 'backups/' prefixes to anyone holding the key (keys are uuid4-unguessable and never serialized publicly, but bucket list/public-read policy is a deployment fact).

Whether S3_API/R2_* env credentials are configured in production (determines which local-fallback branches are reachable); check_env likely guards but unverified here.
